title: 2 Chronicles 17
paragraphs: ¹ Jehoshaphat his son succeeded him as king and strengthened himself against Israel. ² He stationed troops in all the fortified cities of Judah and set garrisons throughout the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim that his father Asa had captured. ³ The LORD was with Jehoshaphat because he followed the earlier ways of his father David before him. He did not consult the Baals ⁴ but sought the God of his father and followed his commands, unlike the practices of Israel. ⁵ The LORD established the kingdom under his control, and all Judah brought gifts to Jehoshaphat, so that he had great wealth and honor.

⁶ His heart was devoted to the ways of the LORD; furthermore, he removed the high places and the Asherah poles from Judah. ⁷ In the third year of his reign he sent officials — Benhail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Michaiah — to teach in the towns of Judah. ⁸ With them were the Levites Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, and Tobijah — and with these Levites were the priests Elishama and Jehoram. ⁹ They taught throughout Judah, taking with them the Book of the Law of the LORD. They went around to all the towns of Judah and taught the people. ¹⁰ The fear of the LORD fell on all the kingdoms of the lands surrounding Judah, so that they did not go to war against Jehoshaphat.

¹¹ Some Philistines brought Jehoshaphat gifts and silver as tribute, and the Arabians brought him flocks — seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred goats. ¹² Jehoshaphat grew more and more powerful; he built forts and store cities in Judah ¹³ and carried out great works in the towns of Judah. He also kept experienced fighting men in Jerusalem. ¹⁴ Their enrollment by families was as follows: from Judah, commanders of units of a thousand — Adnah the commander, with three hundred thousand fighting men; ¹⁵ next, Jehohanan the commander, with two hundred and eighty thousand;

¹⁶ next, Amasiah son of Zichri, who volunteered himself for the LORD's service, with two hundred thousand fighting men. ¹⁷ From Benjamin — Eliada, a valiant soldier, with two hundred thousand men armed with bows and shields; ¹⁸ next, Jehozabad, with a hundred and eighty thousand men equipped for battle. ¹⁹ These were the men who served the king, in addition to those he stationed in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.
